title: Generate product mention summaries for First Alert transcripts
description: Use an LLM to produce one product mention summary per non-empty First Alert transcript. Required output: the main product mentioned by the customer, or exactly 'no product' when none is mentioned. Store reusable artifacts for later BERTopic clustering.

comments.author: ryan
comments.text: Started product mention summarization. Inspecting existing LLM/topic-modeling support and configured LLM credentials before running the batch.

comments.author: ryan
comments.text: Validated the product mention prompt on an 8-transcript pilot. Output shape is one short product noun phrase or exactly 'no product'. Running the resumable full batch against 1,974 non-empty Deepgram transcripts.

comments.author: ryan
comments.text: Completed First Alert product mention summarization with OpenAI gpt-4o-mini. Artifacts were written under corpora/first-alert-openai-stt/analysis/product-mentions/first-alert-main-product-gpt-4o-mini-v1/: product_mentions.jsonl, product_mentions.csv, topic_documents.jsonl, and manifest.json. Stats: 1,974 completed, 0 errors, 91 no product, 1,883 topic-document rows, 199 unique product strings.
